_about: Pass/fail thresholds for stage 6, written 2026-11-28 before run.py was first executed. Each check compares one key of results/<id>.json 'metrics' with max (value <= x), min (value >= x) or equals. Thresholds are not loosened to make a task pass; a changed threshold keeps its old value and the reason under 'changes'. A task with 'runs': N is run N times, each on a fresh simulator, and is verified only when every run passes.

6.01.title: Stationary IMU
6.01.basis: 20 s standing at A. |mean a| should be g = 9.8 (world gravity); roll and pitch from the mean accelerometer vector compared with /odom_gt; nominal IMU rate 100 Hz

6.02.title: Rotate and measure angular rate
6.02.basis: turn in place at a commanded 0.5 rad/s for 8 s; gyro z against the /odom_gt angular rate, steady window = last 5 s of the turn, gyro interpolated to the 50 Hz ground-truth stamps

6.03.title: IMU noise and bias
6.03.basis: 60 s standing. Configured gyro noise sigma = 2e-4 rad/s at 100 Hz (go2_description gazebo.xacro), so N = sigma * sqrt(dt) = 2e-5 rad/s/sqrt(Hz); N estimated as sigma_Allan(tau) * sqrt(tau) at tau = 0.1 s on each axis; ratio = estimate / configured. Accelerometer numbers are reported, not checked: chapter 8 measured a standing z spread of 0.7 to 1.0 m/s2 against a configured 0.017

6.04.title: Integrate the gyro for heading
6.04.basis: turn left about 90 deg, right about 90 deg, then stand 30 s; trapezoidal integral of gyro z against the /odom_gt yaw change

6.05.title: RGB camera
6.05.basis: sensors.xacro: 640x360, 1.2 rad horizontal FOV, so fx = 320 / tan(0.6) = 467.7 px; frame camera_optical

6.06.title: Depth camera
6.06.basis: at A facing +x the floor ahead is clear; floor depth on row v predicted as z = h / (((v - cy) / fy) cos(pitch) + sin(pitch)) with h and pitch of the camera from /odom_gt interpolated at the image's stamp; per frame the median over the 40 centre columns of rows with predicted depth 0.7 to 6 m; the checked value is the worst of 5 consecutive frames

6.07.title: Distance to a wall from depth and from the scan
6.07.basis: p05 lane start (true gap about 2 m to the pallet's flat west face); scan gap = nearest return in +-20 deg minus 0.28 m, depth = median 5x5 centre patch (p05 obstacle.py); true gap from /odom_gt

6.08.title: Lidar point cloud
6.08.basis: lowest beam (-15 deg) meets the floor at h / tan(15 deg), h = lidar height from /odom_gt (base z + 0.10); median over all azimuths

6.09.title: Cloud into the robot frame
6.09.basis: base_link -> lidar_link from tf2 against the URDF (0, 0, 0.10); floor points in base_link should sit at z = -(true base height)

6.10.title: Remove floor and body returns
6.10.basis: labels from /odom_gt: floor = world z < 0.02 m, obstacle = world z > 0.10 m; body = inside |x| <= 0.40, |y| <= 0.20 of base_link

6.11.title: Detect one obstacle
6.11.basis: p05 lane start facing the pallet (west face x = 1.9, y from -3.1 to -1.9); ROI: cluster centroid 0.3 to 4 m ahead and within +-1.0 m sideways (the end of box 1 sits 1.3 m to the left)

6.12.title: Detect several obstacles
6.12.basis: at A; obstacles from make_arena.py; visible = hit first by at least 3 of 720 rays of a 2D ray cast from the lidar against the footprints in make_arena.py; a cluster matches an obstacle or wall when its median point distance to that footprint is under 0.15 m

6.13.title: Stop before a wall
6.13.basis: p05 measure_stops.py at 0.2 m/s, 3 runs, target gap 0.5 m to the pallet's west face; p05 measured 0.479 to 0.489 m at this speed

6.14.title: Stop before a newly spawned obstacle
6.14.basis: p05 stop_at_obstacle.py at 0.2 m/s from the lane start; worlds/new_box.sdf spawned 1 s after walking starts, west face x = 1.2; target gap 0.5 m

6.15.title: Handle missing measurements
6.15.basis: p05 stop_at_obstacle.py, timeout 0.5 s, 10 Hz timer: (a) started with no /front_range for 3 s must not walk; (b) walking at 0.2 m/s, sense.py stopped: a zero within timeout + one tick + 0.05 s

6.16.title: Detect a raised platform from depth
6.16.basis: worlds/platform.world: box 1.0 x 1.2 x 0.12 m centred at (-2.2, -3.5), near edge 1.5 m ahead of the camera at A

6.17.title: Estimate platform height and edges
6.17.basis: height = top plane minus floor plane along the floor normal; edges = 1st and 99th percentiles of the top inliers in world x and y (horizontal pose from /odom_gt); true edges x -2.7, -1.7, y -4.1, -2.9

6.06.old_model: z = h / ((v - cy) / fy), level camera, h = base z + 0.03
6.06.reason: the level-camera prediction ignored the trunk's measured 0.39 deg nose-up pitch, which moves a floor point seen 3 deg below the horizon by about 15 %; the prediction now includes pitch and the camera offset rotated by the true attitude. The sensor and the threshold are the same.

6.06.old_reference: the /odom_gt sample received after the depth frame, one frame per run
6.06.old_basis: at A facing +x the floor ahead is clear; floor depth on row v predicted as z = h / (((v - cy) / fy) cos(pitch) + sin(pitch)) with h and pitch of the camera from /odom_gt, median over the 40 centre columns, rows with predicted depth 0.7 to 6 m
6.06.old_result: verdict changed from run to run: 0.5 % passed, 3.7 % and 3.8 % failed, then 0.61, 1.12, 1.88, 1.53 % passed (separate check by another reader)
6.06.reason: the trunk pitch oscillates by about 0.3 deg while standing and the old reference sample came from a different instant than the image; interpolating /odom_gt at the image stamp gave 1.06 to 1.46 % on 20 consecutive frames. The checked value is now the worst of 5 frames, which is stricter than one frame, and the task is repeated 5 times.

runs.old_rule: one run; the status was that of the last run
runs.new_rule: 5 runs, each on a fresh simulator; verified only when all 5 pass
runs.reason: the verdicts of these three tasks changed between runs with the same code (6.01 gyro mean 2 passes in 5 runs, 6.06 see above, 6.17 far edge 0.093 m in 1 of 3 runs), so the status of a single run depended on which run happened last. Thresholds unchanged.
